About Me
I am a passionate Senior Software Developer with 6+ Years of Experience who loves transforming complex problems into elegant solutions. My journey in tech is driven by an insatiable curiosity for new technologies and a commitment to pushing my skills to their limits. I believe in creating innovative applications that not only solve problems but also deliver exceptional user experiences.

interests.title: interests
interests.description: My interests revolve around modern web development, mobile applications, and emerging technologies. I'm particularly drawn to full-stack development, where I can work across the entire technology stack. I enjoy experimenting with new frameworks, optimizing database performance, and creating seamless user interfaces that bring ideas to life.

education.title: education
education.description: I hold a Bachelor's degree (BCA) in Computer Science from Maharaja Surajmal Institute (2021), achieving a Grade 10. My educational background has provided me with a strong foundation in computer science principles, software engineering practices, and modern development methodologies. Over my 6+ years of professional experience, I complement my formal education with continuous learning through hands-on projects and staying current with industry best practices.
